discipline: Operator-owned (decision D3): no model pre-screen, summaries, clustering, or triage. Entries from all six captures are shuffled and arm-blind (shuffle keyed like the pilot-003 review packet: seeded from the sealed capture digests, key sealed separately) until EVERY entry carries a category. Near-identical proposals across runs are adjudicated once with occurrence_count and the contributing capture ids.

entry_shape.scope_deltas: <differences from the matched reference scope, or null>

unblinding: permitted only after every entry has a category
